Comparative Tree-Space Projection and Topological Validation Pipeline

Source: R/validation.R
validate_phylogenies.Rd

Quantifies topological congruence between the focal supermatrix maximum-likelihood tree generated by `PhyloCactus` and external reference phylogenomic hypotheses (e.g., Amaral *et al.* 2022, Thompson *et al.* 2024, de Vos *et al.* 2025). Employs quantitative tree distance metrics—including Robinson–Foulds (RF) distances and Information-Theoretic distances (`TreeDist`; Smith, 2020)—and multidimensional scaling (MDS) tree-space projections to identify congruent clades and detect topological conflicts across alternative datasets.

Usage

validate_phylogenies(
  trees_mapping_list,
  checklist_csv,
  constraints_map,
  out_dir
)

Arguments

trees_mapping_list

Named list of file paths pointing to Newick/Nexus reference trees and focal tree.

checklist_csv

Character. Path to accepted botanical checklist CSV for taxon name standardization.

constraints_map

Character. Path to taxonomy mapping CSV file.

out_dir

Character. Destination directory path to save validation output tables, tree-space plots, and logs.

Value

A data frame containing pairwise tree distances, RF metrics, and MDS coordinates across evaluated trees.

References

Robinson, D. F., & Foulds, L. R. (1981). Comparison of phylogenetic trees. *Mathematical Biosciences*, 53(1-2), 131-147. doi:10.1016/0025-5564(81)90043-2

Smith, M. R. (2020). Information theoretic measures of phylogenetic tree distance. *Systematic Biology*, 69(6), 1168-1182. doi:10.1093/sysbio/syaa016

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
validate_phylogenies(
  trees_mapping_list = list(
    FocalTree = "bestTree.tree",
    Amaral = "Tree_80MD.tre"
  ),
  checklist_csv = "checklist.csv",
  constraints_map = "taxonomy.csv",
  out_dir = "9_Validation"
)
} # }
